description: Capability set for the Settings webview window. This window is the only context permitted to call load_app_key — the command that returns the raw TfL API key to the renderer. The main window intentionally does not have this capability (MEDIUM-2 / M7 TODO). save_app_key is also listed here for documentation completeness; it is not capability-gated at the Tauri layer because it is a write-only operation with no data-exfiltration risk.
